contract.purpose: Explain Setline as an iPhone execution layer for an existing structured programme, demonstrate the authored-set-to-recorded-history loop, and state the real internal-TestFlight and data boundaries.
contract.purposeSource: Setline PRODUCT.md, PROJECT_STATUS.md, native source, and Site Health dossier
contract.canonicalPurpose: Setline runs a written strength, cardio, or mobility workout one set at a time while preserving authored order, explicit deviations, accurate rest, and planned-versus-recorded evidence.
contract.audience: A person already following a structured training programme who wants less decision-making and data entry between sets.
contract.job: Understand how Setline executes an authored session, what it records, what remains local, what optional sync paths contain, and whether the app is publicly available.
contract.thesis: The landing should feel like the native workout instrument: bright, precise, factual, and dominated by the current action rather than fitness motivation.
contract.system: Matte paper, deep ink, lime execution signals, blue recorded evidence, coral exceptions, condensed numerals, fine rules, and real higher-resolution native screens.
contract.signature: The real current-set board leads the page, followed by the same Today, player, rest, and history sequence used during a workout.
contract.risk: Generic fitness language could make Setline sound like a coach or programme generator, while vague cloud language could collapse iCloud continuity and Hub summaries into one false promise.

projectCheck.note: Setline builds with zero Astro diagnostics and passes 17 required public-surface checks. The complete shared factory builds and validates all eight configured products. Browser inspection at 390, 768, and 1440 found no horizontal overflow or failed image requests.

findings: Independent review found no purpose, lifecycle, visual, or responsive P0/P1 issue.
Residual P2: the gallery leaves generous desktop whitespace, but it preserves evidence scale and the disciplined scorecard rhythm.

answers.product: Setline is a native iPhone workout execution tracker for a programme the user already follows.
answers.audience: It is for someone following structured strength, cardio, or mobility sessions who wants the next set and rest timing ready in the gym.
answers.value: It reduces between-set decisions and preserves an accurate history of the plan, explicit deviations, and actual work.
answers.mechanism: Today resolves authored order, the player separates targets from actuals, explicit skips/extras/deferrals remain evidence, and wall-clock timestamps retain real rest cadence.
answers.proof: Real native screens, exact workout examples, a physical-iPhone internal-build statement, and detailed local/iCloud/Hub boundaries support the claims.
answers.nextAction: Read the beta status while understanding there is no public TestFlight invitation, App Store listing, paid plan, subscription, or checkout.

ownerFeedback.note: The operator authorized end-to-end portfolio landing work without repeated feedback loops; this receipt records local qualification, not deployment approval.
